notes: APV (APV Technologies) chip NTC thermistor, 10 kohm at 25 C, 0603 (1.6 x 0.8 mm). The two B constants are the datasheet's row (3380 K between 25 C and 50 C, which the code '3380FB' names, with its +/-1 % tolerance from the code; 3435 K between 25 C and 85 C, listed without a tolerance of its own). The resistance at other temperatures follows the B constant formula and is not modelled. The board names the same number for TH1 (NTC_CONV) and TH2 (NTC_PLUG). height is 0.8 + 0.15 mm. temp_min and temp_max are the datasheet's operating range including self heating.
